paragraphs: CivilGrid puts utility, environmental and geotechnical records for a site into one platform that project teams scope and plan from. It is aimed at civil engineers and utility operators.

Thousands of datasets covering underground utilities, land rights and geotechnical conditions are consolidated into a map engineers and planners can open in real time. Teams use it to perform site due diligence and plan utility interconnects. Drawings can be started from utility shapefiles, and known geotechnical findings can be downloaded.

Municipal staff are pitched on analyzing projects in their own jurisdiction for resource allocation and infrastructure development. Permitting and project oversight are named as another use. The company says it received a clean SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. It also states that it is certified as a Small Business by the State of California. One published case study covers San Jose Water.
